from pathlib import Path
import sqlite3,json
h=Path.home()
tid='A2Z-V4-ASTRA-PREBUILD-DIRECT-20261008-R4P3'
base=h/'.local/share/prediction-project-executor/campaigns/FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4'
db=base/'models/runtime.sqlite'
assert db.exists(),'ASTRA_RUNTIME_DB_MISSING'
with sqlite3.connect('file:'+str(db)+'?mode=ro',uri=True) as c:
 cols=[r[1] for r in c.execute('pragma table_info(tasks)')]
 allowed=[x for x in ('status','attempt','run','thread','retry_at','last_error','updated_at') if x in cols]
 row=c.execute('select '+','.join(allowed)+' from tasks where id=?',(tid,)).fetchone()
state=dict(zip(allowed,row)) if row else None
timer=h/'.config/systemd/user/prediction-a2z-v4-model@.timer'
instance='prediction-a2z-v4-model@'+tid+'.timer'
targets=[h/'.config/systemd/user/timers.target.wants'/instance,h/'.config/systemd/user/default.target.wants'/instance]
summary={'task':state,'timer_template':timer.exists(),'timer_instance_enabled':any(x.is_symlink() or x.exists() for x in targets),'timer_schedule':next((ln for ln in timer.read_text().splitlines() if ln.startswith('OnCalendar=')),'MISSING') if timer.exists() else 'MISSING','general_timer_enabled':(h/'.config/systemd/user/timers.target.wants/prediction-codex-supervisor.timer').exists()}
print('ASTRA_TIMER_E220 '+json.dumps(summary,default=str,sort_keys=True),flush=True)
assert state,'ASTRA_QUEUE_TASK_MISSING'
assert state.get('status')!='PAUSED_USAGE_LIMIT' or summary['timer_instance_enabled'],'ASTRA_USAGE_LIMIT_NO_15M_TIMER_FOR_R4P3'
assert state.get('status')!='WAITING_RETRY' or summary['timer_instance_enabled'],'ASTRA_WAITING_RETRY_NO_15M_TIMER_FOR_R4P3'
